environment_setting: Country B, a suburban area where many citizens use electric nets to protect their properties
norm_base: Citizens Installing or using electric nets without approval, or installing/using electric nets not complying with safety regulations Detention up to 5 days or fine up to 500 yuan; for serious cases, detention for 5-10 days with possible fine up to 500 yuan

legitimate.legitimate_action: seeking approval and installing electric nets that comply with safety regulations
legitimate.benefits: farm is protected legally, no legal consequences
legitimate.costs: time and money spent on approval process and compliant installation

illegal.illegal_action: installing electric nets without approval or not complying with safety regulations
illegal.benefits: immediate protection of farm, saving time and money
illegal.costs: detention up to 5 days or fine up to 500 yuan; for serious cases, detention for 5-10 days with possible fine up to 500 yuan

legitimate.legitimate_action: inspecting and ensuring all electric nets in the area comply with safety regulations
legitimate.benefits: community safety is maintained, no legal consequences
legitimate.costs: time and effort spent on inspections

illegal.benefits: saving time and effort, avoiding conflicts with citizens
illegal.costs: if discovered, possible disciplinary action or job loss

legitimate.legitimate_action: advising John Doe to seek approval and install compliant electric nets
legitimate.benefits: maintains good relationship with John, no legal consequences

illegal.illegal_action: encouraging John Doe to install electric nets without approval
illegal.benefits: quick solution to protect both farms, saving time and money
illegal.costs: if discovered, both may face legal consequences
